what: Factory camera calibration of one production Vector, as the robot itself reports it through the SDK (CameraConfig) for its 640 x 360 image
read: Read live from the robot by a household session and recorded on or before 2026-11-13 (vector-slam-maze README, v0.2.0 passive verification). A re-read was tried on 2026-11-18 and the robot was off the network.
limits: One robot; calibration varies from unit to unit. Lens distortion coefficients are in the robot's logs, not in the SDK message, and are not here: the view is drawn as an undistorted pinhole.
